summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Patients Module (Pacientes) for Clinic CRM. All 13 requested features tested and working correctly. Login, patient list with table/search/filters, patient form with 4 tabs and Zod validation in Spanish, patient profile page with header/stats/tabs, toggle active/inactive, and file upload section all functional.

issues: Blood type shows 'unknown' instead of '—' when not set - minor inconsistency

context_for_next_testing_agent: Patients module fully functional. Patient form uses React Hook Form + Zod with Spanish validation messages. Patient profile has 5 tabs - Info General shows patient data, Historial Clínico shows appointment history table, Recetas and Órdenes Lab are placeholders ('Próximamente disponible'), Archivos tab supports file upload to Supabase Storage bucket 'patient-files'.
